title: Project settings
readOnly: Only Owners and Admins can change this.
ownerOnly: Only the Owner can do this.

dirty.label: Unsaved changes
dirty.leaveBody: Your unsaved changes will be lost.

general.name: Name
general.keyFormat: Use A–Z and 0–9, 2–10 characters, starting with a letter
general.keyTaken: This key is already used by another project
general.datesOrder: Target end can’t be before the start

workflow.hint: Tasks always use the published version until v{n} is published.
workflow.staying: {n, plural, =0 {No tasks} one {# task} other {# tasks}} in “{status}” stay.
workflow.noRemoved: No status is removed, so no task moves.
workflow.removed: “{status}” is removed: move its {n, plural, one {# task} other {# tasks}} to
workflow.needsDone: Keep at least one Done status
workflow.names: Status names must be filled in and unique
workflow.mapping: Pick where the tasks of each removed status go

fields.hint: Types: text, number, date, single select, multi select, person, URL, checkbox. Deleting a field asks first and shows how many tasks have a value.
fields.name: Field name
fields.typeLocked: The type can’t change after values exist
fields.deleteBody: {n, plural, =0 {No items have a value yet.} one {# item has a value; it will be removed.} other {# items have a value; they will be removed.}}

access.allowGuestsHint: Verified accounts only, task-level grants with expiry
access.membersInviteHint: If on, Members can invite Viewers

import.csvOnly: CSV only. The first row holds the column names.
import.rows: {n, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}} found in {file}
import.commit: Import {n, plural, one {# task} other {# tasks}}
import.note: Dry run changes nothing. Import creates tasks in one batch with an Undo for {minutes} minutes.
import.done: {n, plural, one {# task imported} other {# tasks imported}}

lifecycle.templateHint: Copies phases, workflow, fields and task list (no people, no files, no comments)
lifecycle.archiveHint: Read-only for everyone; hidden from rails; restore anytime
lifecycle.transferHint: 1 · choose a successor (Admin or Manager) → 2 · they accept → 3 · you confirm with your password. Until accepted, you stay Owner.
lifecycle.noSuccessor: No Admin or Manager to choose
lifecycle.deleteHint: Owner only · type the project name · re-enter password. Members see the “deleted” state (SH-02).
